added.name: TareBio
added.long_description: Our platform develops personalized or population-level vaccines for any disease in weeks by changing only one input: the immune imprint. Instead of trying to predict which antigens might work, we read out immune cells already fighting the disease in the body and reverse-engineer antigens that activate them. We've already run our platform end-to-end and created a vaccine that cured cancer in mice.
added.one_liner: Vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks

long_description.before:
Over 70% of B2B trade still happens through emails, PDFs, texts, and phone calls — not because companies prefer it, but because their customers do.

This is the default ordering workflow across industries, and despite decades of ERP software, it remains largely manual.

Response provides the infrastructure for this reality.
We turn unstructured customer messages into ERP-ready draft orders, so teams can review, approve, and move faster without changing how they work.

By automating the space between customer intent and systems of record, Response lets operators scale order volume without hiring more people, outsourcing labor, or retraining customers.

We’re building the missing action layer for how B2B trade actually works.

one_liner.before: Turn customer emails into ERP-ready orders.
one_liner.after: Shop millions of products across your top vendors – all in one place.

long_description.before: Version Story tackles the inefficient and risky process of managing legal document versions that plagues legal teams. long_description.after: Redline in Claude with perfect precision. Version Story is the redlining infrastructure partner for your legal business in the age of AI. Claude searches, summarizes, and creates. Version Story validates. We handcrafted our redline engine in partnership with law firms, including Dentons and Addleshaw Goddard. It is an algorithm, which means the result is the same every time. This is the perfect complement to the generative properties of AI. Wherever you work - whether in Claude, in ChatGPT, or in our standalone app - Version Story provides review and verification you can trust. And for those building out custom tools, we support embedding our redlining in your stack.

long_description.before:
Cozmo is building the loss-intelligence rail for US P&C claims. 

We help TPAs who administer property insurance to process claims efficiently with AI agents that sit at first notice of loss on their side, taking the call, routing the crew and drafting the damage estimate in minutes, work that used to take human teams days. 

This helps to: a) cut the cost per claim now, b) fast-track jobs and ensure contractors are on site without friction, and c) help carriers reprice risk on an individual level rather than in aggregates. 

As claims go AI-native, value will move from the static system of record to whoever owns the loss at origin.
long_description.after:
Cozmo AI helps restoration franchisors, TPAs and adjusters put agents to work on US property insurance claims. Agents are autonomous AI workers that answer intake across all channels, coordinate crews and write up losses. Putting them to work means deploying across the full claim, from first notice of loss to crew dispatch and damage estimate to supplement approval. Work that took human teams days to weeks closes in minutes.

Cozmo is an operating system for the whole claim, end to end, and it runs on top of the estimating software, CRM and phone system already in place. Nothing gets ripped out and nothing gets migrated.

This allows operators to run more jobs per adjuster and send estimates that clear review the first time. On the carrier side, the same work cuts cycle time to hours and leaves a line-item record of every loss, so risk can be priced by property instead of by ZIP code.

Cozmo's platform captures context from every claim it touches and gets sharper with each one.

Go to hellocozmo.ai and book a demo to see the Cozmo AI agents in action.

one_liner.before: The loss-intelligence infrastructure for US P&C insurance claims
one_liner.after: End-to-end AI agents for property claims, from loss report to estimate

long_description.before: OpenVector transforms existing security cameras into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring any new hardware. Users simply describe a task in plain English, and OpenVector automatically builds a custom AI vision model to monitor the feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. It integrates with legacy systems to make calls, send emails, update a POS/CRM, or trigger webhooks in real time. OpenVector enables any camera to do real work.

long_description.before: Florin brings banking, payments, cards, and treasury into one account built for startups - so founders can hold, move, and grow their capital without stitching together half a dozen tools. Unlike platforms that resell another bank's rails, we're building the infrastructure ourselves, end to end, so money moves in real time on a single ledger we own. We start with an invite-only membership for venture-backed companies and expand from there. Named after the florin, the coin that anchored global trade for three centuries, with infrastructure built for how money moves now.
long_description.after: Florin is a full-stack insurance carrier where a world model does the underwriting. When a submission comes in, Florin reads the ACORD forms, then investigates the risk on its own: satellite imagery, permits, public records, even the insured's Instagram, and catches exposures that never make it onto the application. It then simulates tens of thousands of ways the policy year could go, prices the risk, and returns a bindable quote in under a minute instead of weeks. The team is ex-Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Terra Firma, and the bet is that a carrier built this way wins on loss ratio, speed, and cost at the same time.

one_liner.before: The financial operating system for the companies building the future.
one_liner.after: Florin is the insurance carrier with zero underwriters
